rows.grounds: adverb indicating the same manner as the preceding instruction
compound of tri (three), loha (metal), aśma (stone), and tala (surface); locative singular neuter
absolutive of kṛ, indicating a completed action before the main verb
accusative singular masculine object of kṛtvā
compound of su (very) and vistṛta (extensive), modifying vajraṃ

items.question: On what kind of surface should the practitioner make the very extensive thunderbolt in this rite?
premises: The instruction follows the preceding rite.
The thunderbolt is made on a three-metal-and-stone surface.
The thunderbolt is made very extensive.
items.inference: The rite requires fashioning an extensive thunderbolt on a composite metal-and-stone surface.
uncertainties: The exact ritual function of the thunderbolt is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Likewise, having made a very extensive thunderbolt on a surface of three metals and stone.
